Play Instruction Pass other vehicles to reach the check point using the 2 way JOYSTICK for steering and the GEAR BUTTONS for speed.
LEFT Example of CONTROL PANEL. be RIGHT Low HIGH

You must reach the check point before your car is out of fuel to pass to the next stage. If your car is out of fuel, you may continue play by adding more coins and pushing LOW GEAR BUTTON immediately. (Option: DIP SWITCH NO.2) ROAD FIGHTER has six stages, each being more difficult than the previous one.
(THE STAGES) Town (START) forest, bridge, coast road, mountainous area countryside (GOAL),

(OPPONENTS AND OBSTACLES) There are many obstacles on the route to your goal : - Cars, sportscars, articulated lorries (which drop oil drums), tankers plus oil, water, road works and rocks on the road Explosion is caused by hitting articulated lorries, oil drums, tankers, road works or rocks. Hitting cars causes skid and spin which must be skillfully controlled or you will hit crash barrier and explode.
(BONUS POINTS) Extra points and fuel will be added in each stage by driving on to bonus cars.
